entities.summary: The 12th Gyalwang Drukpa Jigme Pema Wangchen (b. 1963-03-05, Rewalsar) was a monarch or head of state of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Rewalsar. Known in the fields of educators & academics.
